mechanism_narrative: A sustained 5-month acceleration in GDP growth (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average signals an expansionary demand shock that boosts corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth decelerates below its 12-month moving average for 3 consecutive months, the signal fails to predict positive 20-day returns in at least 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a tightening labor market that increases wage pressures, compressing corporate profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE remains above 4.0% for 6 consecutive months, the signal fails to predict negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals a contraction in manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below its 6-month moving average
failure_condition: If INDPRO remains above its 6-month moving average for 4 consecutive months, the signal fails to predict negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of triggered instances.
